steps.tx: **SARS-CoV-2 spreads by droplets with short-range air**; R0 peaked near 6 with crowded indoors driving waves. **Spike binds ACE2** after TMPRSS2 priming. **Most symptomatic resolve in 2 weeks**; age with comorbidity decides severity. **Silent hypoxia** fools; oximetry unmasks it. **Anosmia with dysgeusia** marks early waves. **Variants escape** antibodies, retiring monoclonals repeatedly. **Vaccination prevents severe disease**, not every infection.

Spike was reported to bind A C E two after T M P R S S two priming. Most symptomatic were reported to resolve in two weeks, while age with comorbidity decided severity. Silent hypoxia was reported to fool, while oximetry unmasked it. Anosmia with dysgeusia was reported to mark early waves. Variants were reported to escape antibodies, retiring monoclonals repeatedly. Vaccination was reported to prevent severe disease, not every infection.

steps.tx: **Fever with cough with myalgia** within 4 to 5 days of exposure starts most illness; **sore throat with GI upset** accompanies. **Anosmia with dysgeusia** declares COVID where flu lacks it. **Silent desaturation** with clear mentation precedes crashes. **Clots (lung, limb, brain)** complicate hypercoagulable severe disease. **MIS-C in kids** (fever with multisystem inflammation weeks after) mimics Kawasaki. **Long COVID past 3 months** drags fatigue with brain fog.

Anosmia with dysgeusia was reported to declare COVID where flu lacked it. Silent desaturation with clear mentation was reported to precede crashes. Clots in lung, limb and brain were reported to complicate hypercoagulable severe disease. M I S C in kids with fever and multisystem inflammation weeks after was reported to mimic Kawasaki. steps.tx: **RT-PCR (NAAT) is gold**; **rapid antigen misses asymptomatics** and never rules out. **CT ground glass** manages pneumonia but never diagnoses alone. **Lymphopenia with high CRP, ferritin, LDH and D-dimer** stages inflammation. **Troponin with creatinine** catches heart with kidney hits. **SpO2 94% or less, rate above 30, P/F below 300, or half-lung shadows** means severe. **Normal film never excludes** significant disease.
steps.say: R T P C R was ordered as gold, while rapid antigen was reported to miss asymptomatics and never rule out. C T ground glass was reported to manage pneumonia but never diagnose alone. Lymphopenia with high C R P, ferritin, L D H and D-dimer was reported to stage inflammation. Troponin with creatinine was reported to catch heart with kidney hits. S p O two ninety four percent or less, rate above thirty, P F below three hundred, or half-lung shadows were reported to mean severe. Normal film was reported to never exclude significant disease.

steps.tx: **Home isolation with fluids** cures mild disease; **antibiotics never help** without bacterial proof. **Nirmatrelvir 300 mg with ritonavir 100 mg twice daily for 5 days** treats high-risk outpatients within 5 days of onset. **Remdesivir 3 IV doses** covers early disease where pills fail. **Check interactions** before Paxlovid; adjust for kidneys. **Rebound shedding** after improvement extends isolation, not failure.

Nirmatrelvir three hundred milligrams with ritonavir one hundred milligrams twice daily for five days was reported to treat high-risk outpatients within five days of onset. Remdesivir three I V doses were reported to cover early disease where pills failed. Checking interactions before Paxlovid was advised, with adjustment for kidneys. Rebound shedding after improvement was reported to extend isolation, not failure.

steps.tx: **Oxygen to target** leads severe disease; **dexamethasone 6 mg daily for up to 10 days** joins once oxygen starts. **Tocilizumab or baricitinib** rescue severe inflammation within 4 days of escalation. **Prophylactic heparin** counters clots; **therapeutic doses** for the admitted without bleeding risk. **Proning with HFNC** delays tubes; **ARDSnet ventilation** runs intubated lungs. **No steroids without oxygen**; harm outweighs gain.

steps.tx: **Vaccination prevents death**, not sniffles; **boosters shield** elders with comorbid illness. **Masks with ventilation** cut indoor spread. **Isolate 5 days with improving symptoms** per current norms; extend with rebound. **MIS-C gets IVIG with steroids**; **long COVID needs rehab**, not endless antivirals. **Monoclonals lapsed** as variants escaped; check authorisation before use. **Pregnancy vaccinates** safely at any stage.

steps.tx: **Age above 65 with unvaccinated with comorbidity** dies most; **pregnancy with immunocompromise** escalates fast. **Diabetes with obesity with cardiac disease** stack risk. **Kids usually spare** severe lungs. **Therapeutic heparin admitted** unless bleeding threatens. **Remdesivir inpatient** with risk factors; **molnupiravir last resort** with mutagenicity bar in pregnancy. **Bacterial superinfection stays rare**; culture before covering.

steps.tx: **Week two deterioration** marks the inflammatory turn; **day 7 to 10 crash** with rising oxygen needs warns. **ARDS with clots with myocarditis** complicate severe disease. **Cytokine storm (high CRP, ferritin)** drives late worsening more than viral load. **Long COVID past 3 months** brings fatigue, dysautonomia and brain fog. **Recovery takes months** after severe pneumonia; **rehab with graded return** restores function.

steps.tx: **Exam traps:** antigen negative never excludes; NAAT decides. **Steroids in mild disease** harm; oxygen gates steroids. **Antibiotics routine** breed resistance without benefit. **Monoclonal on new variants** fails; check status first. **Isolation ending at day 5 with fever** spreads; improve first. **NSAID fears** overstate; paracetamol leads fever control.
